summary: Completed comprehensive testing of EGMG corporate website - all core functionality working correctly. Backend API endpoints operational, frontend navigation smooth, contact form integration successful, and all major UI components rendering properly.

minor_bugs.issue: Backend accepts invalid contact form data (empty required fields, invalid email format)
minor_bugs.impact: Form validation relies entirely on frontend - backend should validate data

design_issues.issue: Some service sections not found with expected data-testid attributes when filtering

Sticky navigation with HOME, ABOUT, SERVICES, CONTACT links working
Navigation links correctly route to /about, /services, /contact pages
BOOK NOW button in nav links to external Europcar site (https://www.europcar.com/)

Fleet carousel section with vehicle cards visible

Division showcase with 8 brand cards
Testimonials section with 3 testimonials
Instagram placeholder grid with 6 images

About page Vision & Mission split section
Services page with filter tabs (ALL, RENTAL, LEASING, etc.)

action_item_for_main_agent: Minor backend validation improvement needed - add server-side validation for contact form fields (email format, required fields). All core functionality working correctly.
